periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the visible eye patch is oriented diagonally, approximately 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis of the head, tapering toward the snout.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a noticeable downward tapering, with the mass of the patch concentrated dorsally and thinning toward the ventral-rostral point.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a distance roughly equivalent to the width of the individual pinna bases.
